The '''Kintoni garrison''' was a [[Garrison/Legends|military outpost]] on the backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kintoni/Legends|Kintoni]], once held by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and later occupied by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The garrison held a long-range communications/[[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] nexus, which belied Kintoni's geographic isolation.
